_doc: Release specific values of the dialog text tables of this language (tools/translate/texttables.py).  option_vram: aTextDataTableFFFE, the VRAM word address stored in strcDialogDisplay.glyphVramAddr for the selected answer (0-4) of an <OPT n> selection menu (a copy of the engine release's values).  dialog_banks: the ROM banks the dialog packer may fill, in order (a list of bank names; "auto" = defs/translation/engine.json dialog_bank_range + extra_free_banks, the same list).
